inputs.text: [excited] EE… noh… SY… on. In Greek, "cyon" means dog. [serious] And "dirus," in Latin, means terrible, fearsome. The terrible dog.
[happily] People call it the Dire Wolf, yes — [serious] but not a dinosaur: it lived way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] fifty thousand years ago, in North and South America.
[confident] Often in packs, just its own kind. [warmly] And Smilodon, not too far off, hunted the same prey.
